name: Spell Scythe
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. On a hit, the creature drains one spell slot of the targets lowest level available and regains 8 (2d4+4) hit points.
